tbesh_html:
1) sojourning place, dwelling-place, sojourning
1a) dwelling-place
1b) sojourning, lifetime

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence
strongs_1890.derivation: or מָגֻר; from H1481 (גּוּר) in the sense of lodging;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare H4032 (מָגוֹר).
